portInfo.description: Županijska lučka uprava Pula is the county port authority for Pula and nearby harbours. A dedicated passenger terminal is framed as a development project on the authority site; this guide does not invent an opening date. Cruise callers should verify the day’s quay on sailing documents. The Roman amphitheatre is the signature walk-off sight when the ship is on the city waterfront.
